name: usage-ring
description: A band above the prompt for your limits, this chat's context, prompt cache and todos, and its token total and rate

limitsFile.title: Write usage-limits.json
limitsFile.description: Keep the session and weekly limits in $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/usage-limits.json (default ~/.claude) for other tools to read, and seed the rings from it when a session starts.

showModel.title: Show the model
showModel.description: Show the model and its effort (e.g. Opus 5.5 (mid)) in grey next to the pixel Claude.

titles.title: Show group titles
titles.description: Start each group with its title: limits, chat and tokens.

compact.title: Short labels
compact.description: Always use the two-letter labels (Wk, Se, Cx, Ca, Td, Tt, Rt), not only when the terminal is narrow.

showTokens.title: Show the tokens
showTokens.description: Show the tokens group: all tokens this chat used and the rate of the last minute (Tokens 39.5M  6k tok/s).
